title: WPSS/234/2022 of SURENDRA SINGH SHAH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND THROUGH SECRETARY EDUCATION U.K.

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
 THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE ALOK KUMAR VERMA
1st FEBRUARY, 2022
WRIT PETITION (S/S) No.234 of 2022
Between:
Surendra Singh Shah. ...Petitioner
and
State of Uttarakhand and Others.
 ...Respondents
Counsel for the Petitioner : Mr. G.D. Joshi,
learned counsel.
Counsel for the State : Ms. Anjali Bhargav, learned
Additional Chief Standing
Counsel.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
This writ petition has been filed under Article 226 of
the Constitution of India to direct the respondent no.4 to
decide the representation of the petitioner dated 10.01.2022.
2. Heard Mr. G.D. Joshi, the learned counsel for the
petitioner and Ms. Anjali Bhargav, the learned Additional Chief
Standing Counsel for the State through video conferencing.
3. Mr. G.D. Joshi, the learned counsel for the
petitioner, submitted that on 20.11.2020, the respondent nos.
3 & 4 had issued a notification for the appointment on the post
of Assistant Teacher, Grade III in Government Primary School,
District Almora. The petitioner is Graduate, B.Ed. and TET
qualified. He is an Ex-Army personnel and belongs to Other

2
Backward Class category. The petitioner had submitted his
application for the said post. The respondent no.4 uploaded
the fourth waiting list on its website on 05.01.2022. In the
said list, the name of the petitioner was mentioned. On the
same day, the respondents also uploaded a letter, whereby the
respondents directed the candidates to present for the
documents verification on 07.01.2022. On 07.01.2022, the
petitioner participated in the counseling and verification of
documents. On the same day, i.e. on 07.01.2022, the
respondent no.4 issued an appointment order, but, in the said
order, the name of the petitioner has not been included.
Therefore, the petitioner has moved a representation before
the respondent no.4, which is still pending.
4. The learned counsel for the State has no objection
on the submission to direct the respondent no.4 to decide the
representation of the petitioner.
5. In view of the submissions made by the learned
counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of
the case, the present writ petition is disposed of with a
direction to the District Education Officer, Primary Education,
Almora/respondent no.4 to consider and decide the said
representation dated 10.01.2022, submitted by the petitioner,
by a speaking order expeditiously preferably within a period of
four weeks' from the date of the receipt of the order, passed
today, in accordance with the relevant rules. It is made clear
that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of
the case.
___________________
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
 Vacation Judge
Dt: 1st February, 2022
Neha/Reena
